title: Riverfront Retreat-Near Broadway, Pool, Park Free
description:
Stay in style at this modern riverfront condo less than a mile from Broadway and Nashville’s most famous attractions. Enjoy stunning skyline and river views, access to outdoor pool and BBQ grill, shared gym, and laundry room. , The condo has a fully equipped kitchen, 2-bedroom with 2 full baths and is a perfect mix of comfort and convenience. Enjoy covered parking, a private balcony, and easy access to Music City’s best live music, dining, and nightlife, all from your quiet downtown oasis.

The space
About the Space
– 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (sleeps 6)
– Bedroom 1: King bed w/ ensuite bath
– Bedroom 2: Queen bed w/ adjacent full bath
– Living room: Queen sofa bed
– Private balcony with skyline + river views
– Fully equipped kitchen w/ stainless steel GE appliances
– Keurig coffee maker + complimentary local coffee
– 55" Smart HDTV
– Washer + dryer in unit
– Central A/C + heating
– Elevator access (single-level unit, no stairs)
– Free secure parking on premises + street parking available
– Registration: CASR-2023070654

Guest access
Guest Access
– Full private access to the condo and balcony
– Self check-in via smart lock
– Free covered parking on-site + street parking
- Walk to most all of the attractions around us !

Other things to note
We are an apartment style building so a commitment to being a good neighbor is important ,  occupancy limits and quiet hours are needed let's be respectful of others ;-] hopefully they will do the same. 
Events and parties are not allowed without written approval and an additional fee.
Other Notes
– Located downtown — expect some city or train noise
– Quiet hours: 10PM–7AM
– No parties, pets, or smoking
– Exterior cameras monitor parking areas for guest safety
FAQ
➤ How far is Broadway?
Less than one mile, an easy walk or quick drive.
